faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three straightforward tiers: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial offering up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your linked card is billed only when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Does my bot stop working if my internet or phone cuts out?
faq.a: No. Every Ceyo bot runs on its own isolated virtual computer in the cloud. It executes tasks, browses websites, and handles routines 24/7, completely independent of your local device or connectivity.

faq.q: Can I manage my bots through Telegram in Samoa?
faq.a: Yes. You can interact with your bots via one-on-one direct messages or add multiple specialized bots into Telegram group chats, allowing them to collaborate on research, coding, and reporting.

faq.q: Which software and platforms can Ceyo connect with?
faq.a: Ceyo connects with more than 1,000 popular business applications, including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, calendars, and leading CRMs, enabling seamless cross-platform automation.

faq.q: What languages and tasks can the autonomous agent handle?
faq.a: Your agent communicates in English and numerous other global languages. It can independently navigate websites, complete online forms, write and test software code, and prepare comprehensive analytical reports.
